environment: headless GNOME Shell 45.10 --wayland --no-x11, Fractile extension fractile@fractile.io, Ubuntu AppIndicators extension (gnome-shell-extension-appindicator 58), PyQt6 UI

results.name: the AppIndicator extension runs in the test shell and hosts StatusNotifierItems
with the tray icon on, starting the service puts Fractile's icon in the tray, with no window opened
the icon describes itself: name, status Active, an icon image and a tooltip
the GNOME top bar shows the icon (screenshot 30-tray-topbar.png)
the icon's menu (dbusmenu, as the top bar reads it) has the Fractile actions
results.detail: ['Show panel', 'Command palette', 'Save workspace now', 'Restore latest…', 'Workspace dashboard', 'Settings', 'Quit Fractile']

results.name: choosing Settings in the tray menu opens Settings
'Save workspace now' in the tray menu saves a snapshot
clicking the icon shows the placement panel
turning the tray icon off in settings removes it; on brings it back
the UI logged no Python errors
